headline: Nvidia pauses server shipments to Southeast Asia
pages: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners including Dell and Super Micro to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia, the Wall Street Journal reported. The pause is for an unspecified period while Nvidia assesses whether its regional partners meet US export requirements. The focus on those countries stems from Chinese companies tapping Nvidia chips remotely from data centers there. The US Commerce Department closed that loophole earlier this month, reportedly grudgingly. The think tank Institute for Progress estimates that remote data centers like these supply about 24% of China's AI computing power.
The move shows how far Nvidia is going as it faces pressure to change how it handles export compliance. Source: TechCrunch.
